configs.title: ablation from design + fixes (2 faults, R=1): no --ce check (scripts and the turn-start check); 1 fault (the break needs none)
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): endturn writes acked_seq = ledger head at endturn
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): admission counts table rows, not live processes
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): no alarm (the watcher is the only wake source)
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): restore reads the whole staging (no cut at the fence)
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): no drain: failure restarts go on while draining, and the hand-over waits only until the table shows nothing running (zombies ignored)
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): commit.mjs does not compare epochs; the coordinator commits the READY a note names
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): suspicion by liveness, not by progress V
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): replace does not re-check for a READY of the current epoch
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): no status --reconcile at turn start
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): replace.mjs never takes the limit path (restarts are not counted against R)
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): limit path exits before the fence and the stop
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): no watcher.lock; endturn starts a watcher when none of its ce has a fresh tick
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): COMMIT written without exclusive create
ablation from design + fixes (3 faults, R=1): COMMIT without exclusive create and no reconcile
